visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Characters & Micro-Actions: A girl with dark brown hair and silver earrings looks down at a store display. Her hand, featuring light-colored manicured nails, points toward pink boxes on a shelf. Object Specifications: Several pink rectangular boxes with "POP MART" and Powerpuff Girls illustrations are stacked on a shelf. Setting: A brightly lit retail store interior with blurred shelves and ceiling lights in the background. Physical Text: Traditional Chinese subtitles appear at the bottom center. (2) Characters & Micro-Actions: Three young women sit close together. The woman in the center has brown hair with bangs and wears a white New Balance jacket. The woman on the left has blonde hair, and the woman on the right has black hair. They are all smiling and holding pink boxes in front of them. Object Specifications: Pink "POP MART" boxes featuring CRYBABY x The Powerpuff Girls collaboration branding. Setting: An indoor cafe with a distinctive patterned white-and-gray wall and dark-framed decorative elements. Physical Text: White subtitles with black outlines are visible. (3) Characters & Micro-Actions: Close-up of hands tearing open small white plastic blind bags over a marble tabletop. The figures inside are partially visible. Object Specifications: Small, rounded plastic figures with oversized heads and colorful hair. Setting: Shallow depth of field focusing on the table surface and the unboxing action. Physical Text: Dynamic subtitles continue to change rapidly at the bottom. (4) Characters & Micro-Actions: The woman in the white jacket holds a black-haired figure directly in front of the camera lens, smiling with squinted eyes. The other two women are visible in the background, also holding their figures. Object Specifications: A small Buttercup figure with a transparent body and a signature green-and-black outfit. Setting: The cafe background remains consistent with warm, even lighting. Physical Text: Subtitles reflect the characters' names. (5) Characters & Micro-Actions: All three women hold their respective figures toward the camera in a group shot. They are laughing and looking at the lens. Object Specifications: A complete set of six figures—three large ones and three smaller ones—representing the Powerpuff Girls. Setting: Final high-angle view of the characters arranged on the marble table. Physical Text: A pink text overlay appears at the top center describing the product.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Three young Asian women in their 20s. One has blonde hair and a striped top; one has brown hair with bangs and a white New Balance zip-up jacket; one has black hair and a black top.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: First scene is a Pop Mart retail store with product-filled shelves. Second scene is a cafe with a hexagonal-patterned wall and a marble-top table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Vocals: A high-pitched, energetic female voice says "Last three," with a rising, excited intonation. Music: An upbeat pop track with a synth-heavy melody and a clear 4/4 electronic drum beat begins. SFX: Faint metallic clink from a shelf. Ambient: Low-level buzz of a retail environment. (2) Vocals: Three female voices overlap in conversation, laughing and expressing surprise. The cadence is fast and rhythmic. Music: The BGM maintains its tempo, providing a cheerful background layer. SFX: Soft sliding sounds of cardboard boxes being moved. Ambient: Distant, muffled chatter. (3) Vocals: Clear, close-up voices in a cafe setting; the speakers ask each other which toy they want. Tone is casual and animated. Music: The pop track continues with a repetitive, infectious melody line. SFX: Distinctive plastic crinkling as blind bags are handled. Ambient: Room tone of an enclosed space. (4) Vocals: Sharp gasps and high-arousal exclamations as figures are revealed. One voice shouts "Oh my god!" Music: BGM persists. SFX: Loud plastic rustling and a light thud of objects placed on a hard surface. Ambient: Quiet background chatter from other patrons. (5) Vocals: In a final, synchronized moment, the group shouts "Yeah!" and "Very cute!" with very high pitch and valence. Music: The BGM concludes with a rhythmic synth flourish. SFX: A subtle post-production 'ding' sound effect accompanying the visual reveal. Ambient: Faint cafe hum.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Acquisition -> Group Discussion -> Action -> Reveal
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a successful unboxing session of the POP MART x CRYBABY Powerpuff Girls collaboration figures. The video aims to share the excitement of collecting blind boxes and the joy of finding specific or rare items with friends.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of the brand boxes, the retail store, and high-quality close-ups of the specific product collection.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy social media editing style with colorful overlays and fast cuts to maintain viewer engagement during a product unboxing.
